title: Senior GRC Consultant
description:
About the role

HTS Consulting is hiring a Senior GRC Consultant with at least 4 years of hands-on experience in governance, risk and compliance and strong working knowledge of Indian financial sector regulations.

You will lead regulatory compliance and audit engagements for banks, NBFCs, payment system operators, fintechs, stock brokers and their technology service providers, covering RBI, NPCI, SEBI, CERT-In and DPDP Act requirements alongside ISO 27001, ISO 22301 and PCI DSS.

You will own client engagements from scoping to closure, be the main point of contact for client CISOs, compliance and IT teams, review the work of GRC Analysts, and present findings to senior management and board committees. The role is full-time and work from office only in Bangalore (no hybrid or remote option), and we are looking for candidates who can join immediately or within 15 days.

What you will do

Regulatory compliance (RBI, NPCI, SEBI and others)

• Run gap assessments and compliance reviews against RBI directions, including the Master Direction on IT Governance, Risk, Controls and Assurance Practices, the Cyber Security Framework, Outsourcing of IT Services, Digital Payment Security Controls, Payment Aggregator guidelines and Cyber Resilience for PSOs.

• Carry out NPCI compliance reviews and member audits for UPI, IMPS, NACH, AePS, RuPay and BBPS participants, and prepare annual system audit and certification reports.

• Assess SEBI regulated entities against the Cybersecurity and Cyber Resilience Framework (CSCRF) and related circulars, and support cyber audit and VAPT reporting to SEBI and the exchanges.

• Support CERT-In directions (incident reportsync), UIDAI AUA and KUA requirements and DPDPAct compliance programmes.

• Track new regulatory circulars, assess theidate compliance checklists and controllibraries.

• Prepare responses to regulator inspections ns, such as RBI IT examinations and SEBIinspections, and drive Risk Mitigation Plans to closure.

Governance and frameworks

• Design and implement ISMS, BCMS and PIMS programmes aligned to ISO 27001, ISO 22301 and ISO 27701, and support PCI DSS and SOC 2 readiness.

• Draft and review board-approved policies such as information security, cyber security, IT outsourcing, cyber crisis management and business continuity policies.

• Build integrated control frameworks that map RBI, NPCI, SEBI, CERT-In, ISO and PCI DSS requirements to one common set of controls.

Risk, audit and third parties

• Lead IT and cyber risk assessments, maintain risk registers and present the risk posture to the IT Strategy Committee, Risk Management Committee and senior management.

• Plan and lead internal audits, IS audits and regulatory audits, and write audit reports with risk-rated observations and agreed remediation.

• Run third-party and outsourcing risk assessments in line with RBI and SEBI requirements, including due diligence, contract clauses and periodic reviews.

• Review technical evidence such as access reviews, VAPT and configuration audit reports, SOC and log monitoring, and backup and DR drill results.

Ongoing compliance maintenance

• Maintain a compliance calendar for each client covering regulatory submissions, audits, policy reviews, drills and renewals.

• Run quarterly compliance reviews and periodic control testing, and keep evidence ready for regulator and auditor requests.

• Support management reviews, committee meetings and board reporting with compliance dashboards, KRIs and action trackers.

Engagement leadership and reporting

• Lead client engagements from scoping to closure, manage timelines and deliverables, and be the main contact for client CISOs and compliance heads.

• Review and quality-check the work of GRC Analysts, and mentor them on regulations and audit practice.

• Maintain a tracker of all open gaps, observations and action items, follow up with owners and drive every open point to closure within the agreed timeline.

• Share weekly status reports with clients and a monthly summary for management, and escalate overdue and high-risk items early.

What you bring

• Minimum 4 years of hands-on experience in GRC, IS audit or regulatory compliance, with at least 2 years in BFSI, payments or capital markets.

• Strong working knowledge of RBI cyber security and IT governance directions, and practical exposure to NPCI and SEBI CSCRF requirements.

• Working knowledge of CERT-In and DPDP Act requirements.

• Hands-on experience implementing or auditing ISO 27001, with exposure to ISO 22301, ISO 27701 and PCI DSS.

• Experience leading audits or regulatory assessments and writing clear, risk-rated reports.

• Good understanding of IT and security controls across infrastructure, applications, cloud, payments and data protection.

• Confident communicator who can present to CISOs, senior management and board committees.

• Experience managing multiple engagements at the same time and mentoring junior team members.

• Disciplined follow-up, with experience tracking open items to closure and sharing regular status reports.

description:

Collins Aerospace is seeking an experienced SAP Batch Administration Specialist to support and optimize enterprise batch processing environments across SAP and non-SAP platforms.
  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for monitoring, scheduling, administering, and troubleshooting business-critical batch jobs to ensure operational stability, seamless business processing, and reliable system performance.
  
  
You will work closely with SAP Basis, Infrastructure, Network, Cybersecurity, SAP Security, and Functional Application teams to manage batch processing operations, resolve incidents, and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in SAP batch administration, enterprise workload scheduling, and Redwood RunMyJobs (RMJ), along with experience supporting global 24x7 enterprise environments.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Administer, monitor, and optimize enterprise SAP and non-SAP batch processing environments.
* Manage enterprise scheduling solutions, including Redwood RunMyJobs (RMJ), to ensure reliable execution of business-critical jobs.
* Monitor SAP background jobs and RMJ workflows, identify failures, and initiate recovery activities based on business impact and severity.
* Schedule, modify, and maintain recurring batch jobs across daily, weekly, monthly, and event-driven processing cycles.
* Collaborate with SAP Basis, Infrastructure, Network, Cybersecurity, SAP Security, and Functional Application teams to resolve operational issues.
* Support critical business processing activities, including MRP cycles, IDocs, interfaces, month-end close, file transfers, and integration workflows.
* Ensure compliance with audit, cybersecurity, regulatory, and operational standards.
* Follow ITIL processes for incident, problem, change, and service management.
* Maintain operational documentation, runbooks, process standards, and knowledge articles.
* Participate in global 24x7 on-call support rotations, including weekends and holidays.
* Identify opportunities for automation, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement.
* Leverage enterprise partnerships with SAP, Redwood Software, and other technology providers to improve batch processing operations.

**SAP Batch Administration**

* Administer SAP background processing using SAP transaction codes:

+ SM36 – Job Definition and Scheduling
+ SM37 – Job Monitoring and Management
+ SM61 – Operation Modes
+ SM66 – Global Work Process Monitoring

* Monitor scheduled batch jobs and ensure successful execution.
* Analyze job performance, runtime statistics, spool outputs, and job logs.
* Troubleshoot job failures and coordinate resolution across application, infrastructure, and network teams.
* Perform job restarts, resubmissions, and recovery procedures in accordance with operational guidelines.
* Identify recurring job failures and recommend process optimization strategies.

**Redwood RunMyJobs (RMJ) Operations**

* Monitor enterprise job execution across SAP and non-SAP environments using RMJ dashboards.
* Review queue health, process server availability, workload distribution, and job dependencies.
* Analyze and resolve RMJ alerts related to job failures, long-running jobs, event-waiting conditions, assigned jobs, dispatched jobs, and process server shutdowns.
* Investigate long-running jobs and determine appropriate corrective actions.
* Validate runtime dependencies and event-waiting conditions.
* Perform job recovery activities, including restarting failed jobs, resubmitting jobs, marking jobs complete when appropriate, and holding or releasing jobs from ICE status.
* Monitor and support MRP processing, IDoc processing, month-end activities, File Watcher jobs, and event-triggered workflows.
* Review and download spool logs for troubleshooting and validation.
* Configure and maintain alerting thresholds and monitoring capabilities.
* Support secure RMJ connectivity across hybrid and cloud-hosted SAP environments.

* Analyze and disposition RMJ operator messages and system alerts.
* Perform root cause analysis of recurring job failures and production issues.
* Escalate critical production incidents according to established support procedures.
* Coordinate with job owners and stakeholders for priority and month-end processing failures.
* Maintain accurate operational records, incident documentation, and audit trails.
* Participate in post-incident reviews and corrective action planning.
* Ensure adherence to ITIL-based incident, problem, change, and service management practices.

**Operational Excellence**

* Monitor enterprise system performance and identify trends affecting batch processing.
* Implement automation and monitoring enhancements to reduce manual effort and improve reliability.
* Maintain documentation covering operational processes, recovery procedures, and best practices.
* Support enterprise audit activities and regulatory compliance requirements.
* Contribute to continuous service improvement initiatives and operational excellence programs.

**Qualifications You Must Have**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Typically 6+ years of experience in SAP technical operations, with a strong focus on batch scheduling and job monitoring.

description:

availability, stability, and service levels against business-agreed commitments.

Xylem, SAP, the hyperscaler, and the AMS partner, and keep it explicit.

business leadership, and formal RCCA through to closed corrective actions.

background workload balancing, RFC and gateway tuning, and system parameter optimization.

volumetrics from deployment waves rather than initial estimates.

management, and validated restore capability across all environments.

testing on a published cadence, not an assumed capability.

procedures, and regular DR exercises with documented results.
  
  

* Ensure business continuity plans are current, tested, and understood by the people who would have to

execute them at three in the morning.
  
  

* Maintain audit-ready evidence of backup integrity, restore validation, and DR test outcomes.

**Landscape management and security operations**

* Own system landscape architecture, client strategy, system refresh and copy processes, and environment

provisioning for build, test, training, and deployment waves.
  
  

* Own transport landscape administration and change control in partnership with the ABAP and BTP team.
* Manage technical security operations: system hardening, patching cadence, certificate and encryption

management, secure integration configuration, and audit and compliance evidence.
  
  

* Partner with security and GRC on privileged access controls, including firefighter administration, emergency

access, and log review discipline within required windows.
  
  

* Own monitoring and observability across the landscape — Focused Run, Cloud ALM, EarlyWatch, and

integration with enterprise monitoring — with alerting that drives action rather than noise.
  
  
**Deployment and team leadership**

* Provide Basis readiness for every deployment wave: environment strategy, cutover technical planning,

downtime minimization, mock cutover support, and hypercare coverage.
  
  

* Lead a global Basis team across onshore and offshore with follow-the-sun coverage for production support.
* Manage AMS partner Basis delivery quality, staffing continuity, and adherence to Xylem operational standards.

**Qualifications**
**Required**

* 15+ years in SAP Basis and technical operations, with at least 5 years leading global teams.
* Deep hands-on S/4HANA Basis expertise — installation, migration, upgrade, and operations at global scale.
* Expert-level HANA database administration: memory and persistence management, performance monitoring,

partitioning, system replication, and troubleshooting.
  
  

* Proven ownership of backup, recovery, HA, and DR for business-critical SAP systems, including demonstrated

restore and failover testing rather than documented intent.
  
  

* Demonstrated production ownership through S/4HANA go-lives and hypercare in a multi-wave global program.
* Strong command of system performance tuning, capacity planning, and workload management.
* Experience with SAP Solution Manager, Focused Run, and Cloud ALM for monitoring and technical operations.
* Landscape and transport management, system copy and refresh, and environment strategy at scale.
* Composure and command presence in a production outage, with the ability to communicate technical status to

business leadership without either minimizing or catastrophizing.
  
  
**Preferred**

* RISE with SAP private cloud operations experience and hyperscaler platform knowledge (Azure, AWS, or

GCP).
  
  

* SAP MaxAttention or Enterprise Support engagement management.
* Automation and infrastructure-as-code for SAP operations; scripting in shell, Python, or Ansible.
* BTP platform operations, connectivity, and Cloud Connector management.
* SAP security, GRC, and audit experience in a regulated or publicly listed environment.
* Manufacturing or industrial operations context, where plant downtime has immediate physical and revenue

consequence.
  
  
**Success in the First 12 Months**
Published availability and performance SLOs with the business, and delivery against them. A validated backup
  
  
and restore capability with tested RPO and RTO, not assumed. A completed DR exercise with documented
  
  
results and closed gaps. A clear, agreed RACI across Xylem, SAP, the hyperscaler, and AMS with no unowned
  
  
space in it. Reduced technical incident volume and faster mean time to resolution. And clean Basis readiness
  
  
through every deployment wave, with downtime inside committed windows.
  
  
**Operating Principles You Will Work Under**

* Products, not projects. Persistent teams aligned to value streams, funded by capacity rather than project

cycles, each paired with a business process owner accountable for the outcome.
  
  

* Clean core is non-negotiable. Extensions live on BTP, the core stays standard, and custom code is

governed at the point of creation.
  
  

* Paved road, not toll booth. Golden paths, reference architectures, and reusable patterns, with guardrails

enforced in the pipeline rather than in a design authority meeting.
  
  

* Compliance by default. Controls are designed into the platform and evidenced automatically, so control

integrity holds at deployment scale.
  
  

* Accountable for value, not volume. Success is measured in business process KPIs, adoption, and realized

value, not tickets closed or hours delivered.
  
  

* Intelligent enterprise by design. AI and agent enablement, and the data readiness that makes both credible,

are owned capabilities.
  
  

* Global template authority, local execution. Template integrity is held centrally through the current

deployment horizon, with a defined path to greater product-team autonomy.

title: Staff Engineer, Cloud Platform - India
description:
**All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.**

  
About JumpCloud®
  

JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

  
  
**JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.**

**About the Role**
  

We're hiring a Staff Engineer to join JumpCloud's Cloud Platform organization, with a focus on observability and FinOps.

  

You'll own the questions that matter most as we scale toward 99.99% availability: can we see what's happening across the platform, how fast do we recover when something breaks, can we survive a regional outage, and are we spending enough to run it all? This is a hands-on staff role. You'll set the technical direction for observability, incident management, disaster recovery, and cloud cost, write the code and AI-driven automation that make it real, and work closely with engineering, customer support, finance, and leadership.

**What You'll Be Doing**
  

**Observability**

  

  
* Set the technical direction for observability across JumpCloud's cloud platform: metrics, logs, traces, and events, on AWS and GCP.
  
* Build and run our observability stack (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry), including standard instrumentation libraries and collectors that teams adopt by default.
  
* Define SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets with service owners, and build the dashboards and burn-rate alerts that hold us to a 99.99% SLA.
  
* Cut alert noise. Make sure every page is actionable, routed to the right owner, and backed by a runbook.
  
* Shorten detection and recovery times (MTTD and MTTR) by improving tracing, correlation, and incident tooling.
  
* Manage observability cost itself: cardinality, log volume, sampling, and retention, so visibility grows without the bill growing with it.
  
  

  

**FinOps**

  

  
* Own cloud cost visibility: tagging standards, cost allocation by team and service, and showback reports that engineers actually read.
  
* Find and deliver savings through right-sizing, autoscaling, spot capacity, storage tiering, idle-resource cleanup, and data-transfer reduction.
  
* Shape our commitment strategy (Savings Plans, Reserved Instances, committed-use discounts) with finance, based on real usage data.
  
* Build automation and guardrails, such as budget alerts, anomaly detection, and policy-as-code checks, that catch waste before it ships.
  
* Define unit economics, like cost per customer or per device, and make cost a normal input to design reviews.
  
* Partner with finance on forecasting and budgeting, and explain cloud spend clearly to leadership.
  
  

  

**Incident Management and AI-Driven Automation**

  

  
* Own the incident management process end to end: severity levels, on-call rotations, escalation paths, communication, and the tooling behind them.
  
* Lead major incidents as incident commander or senior escalation point, and keep customers and leadership informed.
  
* Run root cause analysis (RCA) for significant incidents, and drive the follow-up actions to completion so issues don't repeat.
  
* Build AI agents that correlate alerts, logs, traces, and recent changes to find the likely root cause automatically.
  
* Build self-healing automation and AI agents that detect and fix known issues before they escalate or reach customers, with safe guardrails and human approval where it matters.
  
* Measure and improve incident health over time: MTTD, MTTR, repeat incidents, and on-call load.
  
  

  

**Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery**

  

  
* Own JumpCloud's business continuity (BCP) and disaster recovery (DR) strategy for the cloud platform.
  
* Define RTO and RPO targets with product and leadership, and design the architecture to meet them.
  
* Design and build the DR site and recovery environment across AWS and GCP, including data replication, backups, failover, and failback.
  
* Plan and run regular DR tests and failover drills, document the results, and close the gaps they reveal.
  
* Keep DR runbooks, recovery automation, and BCP plans current, and support audit and customer requests for evidence.
  
  

  

**Across Everything**

  

  
* Write production-quality Go or Python for tooling, exporters, data pipelines, and automation.
  
* Work closely with customer support teams: turn support tickets and escalations into monitoring, alerts, and fixes, and give support the visibility they need to answer customers quickly.
  
* Partner with product engineering teams on reliability, recoverability, and cost-aware design.
  
* Write design docs, review architecture across engineering, and mentor engineers on observability and cost-aware design.
  
  

  
**We're Looking For**
  

  
* 10+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 4 years in platform, SRE, or infrastructure roles running 24/7 SaaS systems at scale.
  
* **Observability depth:**
  You've designed and run observability at scale with Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry. You know how to instrument services, set meaningful SLOs, and build alerts people trust.
  
* **FinOps track record:**
  You've cut cloud spend in a measurable way, and you can show the numbers. You're comfortable with AWS Cost Explorer, CUR, Kubecost, or similar tools, and with commitment planning.
  
* **Strong coding skills:**
  You've built production tooling and automation in Go or Python, not just dashboards and scripts.
  
* **AWS, GCP, and Terraform:**
  strong hands-on production experience with both AWS and GCP, and with Terraform for infrastructure as code. Production Kubernetes experience is expected.
  
* **Incident management:**
  You've owned on-call and incident processes, led major incidents, and run RCAs that led to lasting fixes.
  
* **AI and automation:**
  You've built automation for incident response or remediation, and you have hands-on experience building AI agents or LLM-based tools for root cause analysis or auto-remediation.
  
* **BCP and DR:**
  You've designed and tested disaster recovery for production SaaS systems, including RTO and RPO targets, DR sites, replication, and failover drills.
  
* **Engineering and customer focus:**
  You have a software engineering background and have worked closely with customer support teams to resolve issues and reduce customer impact.
  
* **Staff-level influence:**
  You've driven change across multiple teams without direct authority, and you can get engineers to care about both reliability and cost.
  
* Clear communication with engineers, finance, and leadership. You can turn usage and cost data into a simple story and a clear decision.
  
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  
* A strong team player who lives our core values: building connections, thinking big, and getting 1% better every day.
  
  

  
**Preferred Qualifications**
  

  
* FinOps Certified Practitioner, or hands-on experience applying the FinOps Framework.
  
* Experience with cost tools such as CloudHealth, Vantage, Cloudability, or AWS Compute Optimizer.
  
* Experience building cost and usage data pipelines (AWS CUR, BigQuery billing export, Athena) and reporting on top of them.
  
* Experience running observability in-house at scale (Prometheus/Thanos/Mimir, Loki, Tempo) and weighing that against SaaS vendors.
  
* Experience with eBPF-based monitoring, continuous profiling, or real user monitoring.
  
* Experience negotiating or managing vendor contracts for observability or cloud spend.
  
* Open-source contributions, published writing, or conference talks on observability or FinOps.

  



**Where you’ll be working/Location:**

  

JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.

  
  

**You must be located in and authorized to work in the country noted in the job description to be considered for this role.**

  
  

Please note: There is an expectation that our engineers participate in on-call shifts. You will be expected commit to being ready and able to respond during your assigned shift, so that alerts don't go unaddressed.

  
  

**Language:**

  

JumpCloud has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently.  Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

  
  

**Why JumpCloud?**

 

  

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.  

  

 

  

One of JumpCloud's three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO

JumpCloud is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

  
  

**Scam Notice:**

These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. title: Director, Systems Architecture & Modernization
description:
At Quickbase, we help organizations build better ways to run their operations. Our products give teams the flexibility to create applications around how their work actually happens, connecting people, information, and processes so they can keep work moving as needs change.
  
  
For more than 25 years, organizations have turned to Quickbase to solve operational challenges that off-the-shelf software wasn't built for. Today, we’re building on that foundation with new products and new possibilities for how people create, adapt, and improve the systems their work depends on.
  
  
Working at Quickbase means helping find better ways forward. We’re a team of curious, collaborative people who care about solving problems, learning as we go, and building things that make work better for our customers and each other.

**Job Title** : Director, Systems Architecture and Modernization

**Reporting to** : Chief Business Transformation Officer

**Location** : Bangalore, India

**Department** : Enterprise Transformation Engine

  

**The Mandate**
===============

Quickbase's Core systems weren't built for what comes next. Every AI workflow, every agentic capability, every attempt to let people outside ETE build against our data runs into the same wall: systems that are tightly coupled, hard to decouple, and carrying years of technical debt.

This role exists to tear that wall down. You will lead the people who build and maintain Core Architecture and Systems Engineering, reduce the debt in systems like Salesforce, and make headless real at Quickbase — our systems exposing clean APIs instead of forcing every integration through custom logic. That is the precondition for everything else ETE is building, including the Builder platform that will let the business build AI workflows without waiting on ETE.

You will also own the technical direction for the biggest systems project ETE will run this cycle: rebuilding our Core Quoting and Billing infrastructure.

**What You'll Lead**
====================

**Team Leadership**

* Lead the combined Core Architecture and Systems Engineering teams — architects and Salesforce/systems engineers

* Set the technical bar for the people who build and maintain the systems Quickbase's revenue motion runs on

* You are accountable for the outcome. You do not chair a review committee. You make the call and document it.

**Systems Modernization & Technical Debt**

* Own the reduction of technical debt in Salesforce and adjacent Core systems: fewer custom flows, less undocumented logic, a system that can actually be reasoned about

* Define and drive the headless architecture strategy — decouple Core systems behind clean APIs so they can be consumed safely by any system, human, or agent that needs them, not just the ones built to know their internals

* Partner with the Sr. Manager of Systems Management on platform health and technical debt prioritization

**CPQ & Billing Platform**

* Own the technical architecture and design standards for the CPQ and Billing Platform rebuild

* Run the architecture review gate — nothing ships without your sign-off on the design

* Delivery cadence, stakeholder management, and program timeline sit with the assigned Program/BPM lead. Your job is the design underneath it, not the standup.

**Builder Platform — Precondition, Not Ownership**

* Make Core systems headless and API-exposed so the AI Automation & Engineering team can build the Builder platform on top of them safely

* You do not own the semantic layer, the skills repository, or the AI orchestration infrastructure. That work sits elsewhere, full stop.

* Your job is making Core systems safe and ready to be reached — not defining what Builder does with them

**What's Next**

* Once the above is underway, you have the latitude to reshape or reallocate resources across your own team toward forward-looking architecture work — agentic system design, patterns for a PLG motion, whatever the next constraint turns out to be

* This is not a separately funded mandate. It's your call, with your team, once the foundation is solid.

**What We Look For**
====================

* **Stack polyglot.** As comfortable in a Salesforce CPQ data model as evaluating what “headless” means for a legacy monolith. You don't default to the tool you know — you default to what the business needs.

* **Owner, not coordinator.** You own the standards, the review process, the quality bar, and the outcome for your domain, completely.

* **AI-fluent by necessity, not by title.** You understand what agentic AI needs from the systems underneath it well enough to make Core systems safe to build against. You are not building the AI infrastructure yourself.

* **Governance-first instinct.** You partner with Security and Legal on architecture guardrails because you know what breaks when you don't, not because a committee told you to.

* **Communicator across registers.** You can walk Finance through why the Billing data model matters for their close process, then turn around and review integration architecture with an engineer. Neither conversation intimidates you.

* **Comfortable with ambiguity, allergic to vagueness.** You can start before the full picture is clear, but once you have a direction, you write it down and hold people to it.

**What Success Looks Like, Year One**
=====================================

* Measurable reduction in Salesforce technical debt — custom flow/code surface, undocumented logic

* A defined and adopted headless architecture standard, with a first wave of Core systems exposed behind it

* CPQ & Billing Platform: architecture locked, review gate operating, first milestone shipped

* Core systems ready for Builder to safely consume, with the handoff defined and working

**Qualifications**
==================

* 10+ years in enterprise systems architecture, including 3+ years in a senior technical leadership role with direct people management

* Deep Salesforce platform architecture experience — Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, CPQ, multi-org/multi-product environments

* Direct experience decoupling monolithic or tightly-coupled systems into API-first, headless architectures

* Hands-on integration architecture experience — Workato, MuleSoft, or equivalent iPaaS

* Enough fluency in AI/agentic system design to know what those systems need from the platform underneath them, even without owning the AI stack itself

* Proven track record leading distributed technical teams across geographies

* B2B SaaS experience strongly preferred

**Preferred**

* Familiarity with PE-backed operating environments

* Experience leading architecture through a PLG transformation or major GTM motion change

* Familiarity with Snowflake, dbt, or the modern data stack

* Experience with AI governance frameworks in enterprise contexts
  

  

**Important Notices**  
**Recorded Interviews.** Quickbase uses an interview recording tool to record and transcribe interviews for evaluation purposes in accordance with applicable privacy laws. By participating in an interview, you consent to this recording and transcription.
  
**Interview Integrity.** AI is part of how we work at Quickbase — we expect you to use it too. Your application and interviews should still reflect you and your own thinking. We'll tell you when AI is encouraged throughout the selection process. Misrepresentation at any stage may result in removal from consideration for this and future roles.
  
**How We Review Applications** We use AI throughout our hiring process to help review, screen, schedule interviews, and assess applications. These tools support our team's review; they do not replace it, and every hiring decision is made by a person.

  
  
  

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

Quickbase is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply – even if you don’t meet every qualification listed. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.
